sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,u.id,w.id,t.id,'manual',LEFT(:title,180),CONCAT('From ',:sender,': ',:message),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_user_tenants recipientMembership INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=recipientMembership.userId AND u.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=NULLIF(:workflowId,'') AND w.tenantId=recipientMembership.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_tasks t ON t.id=NULLIF(:taskId,'') AND t.workflowId=w.id AND t.tenantId=recipientMembership.tenantId WHERE recipientMembership.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND recipientMembership.userId=:recipientUserId AND recipientMembership.isActive=1 AND recipientMembership.membershipStatus='active' AND (:workflowIdEmpty='' OR w.id IS NOT NULL) AND (:taskIdEmpty='' OR t.id IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants senderMembership WHERE senderMembership.tenantId=recipientMembership.tenantId AND senderMembership.userId=:senderUserId AND senderMembership.isActive=1 AND senderMembership.membershipStatus='active') AND NULLIF(TRIM(:titleRequired),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:messageRequired),'') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
